_extensions.why: Everything below is a rule this plant schedules against that the current input contract has no field for. It is the Extend column of the deck's slide 39, stated in the planner's own terms.

forbidden_pairs.need: A changeover matrix cell that means 'never', not 'expensive'. Today a forbidden pair can only be approximated with a very large changeover time, which an optimiser may still buy.

rows.why: Azo residue is not removable to the amine limit on this train

yield_distribution.need: A yield mean and spread per SKU, and a plan that re-costs the campaign as each batch assays.

secondary_resource_duty.need: A per-hour capacity on a shared resource, and a duty PROFILE per operation so the peak of concurrent batches binds instead of an average.

derate.why: Ambient derating of the brine chillers, April to June

waste_limits.need: A daily limit per waste category with carry-over, and a recovery credit that returns material later.

hazard_licence.need: A licensed ceiling per hazard class over the whole site, checked across time, plus bund segregation.

spec_allocation.need: Allocation that matches a lot's measured assay, impurity and PSD to the order's spec, the customer's approved site and route, and a minimum remaining shelf life — blending lots where one will not do.
